note: City of Fayette park and campground on an island formed by the Volga River, reached by a bridge, with RV sites on open grassy loops, tent sites, a playground, three large picnic shelters and easy river access for kayaking, canoeing and tubing; the camping loops sit back from the water behind a treeline.  Campers register and pay by QR code within an hour of arrival, quiet hours run from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m., and check-out is at 4 p.m. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 RV ($150/week), 20/30/50A, water at half the RV sites, showers, dump $2, 14-night limit, ParkWithUs booking. Added sites (20 RV + 6 tent, 50 ft), season closes Nov 1 (city banner), booking url. Waterfront lead: riverview -> not waterfront (Volga ~20-25 m wide here, RV sites behind trees). Pin ~95 m off, fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade lead: riverview -> not waterfront): on NAIP the Volga beside the island is about 17-25 m of open water (Overpass was down, imagery estimate), so it is creek-sized under the ~30 m rule, and there is no creek-view value. The ParkWithUs map and imagery put every RV site on the island's interior loops: sites 1-10 along the road east of the bathroom 90-150 m from the river with a tree belt between; the south loop (11-13A) comes closest, its end roughly 20-40 m from the bank through a continuous tree strip. No campsite photo shows the river. Nothing supports a view from the pads, so under the 2026-11-02 rule this goes down to not waterfront. (The river access/kayak launch on the west side is day use.)
CHECK-OUT: the city page says 'Check-out time is 4 :00 PM'; the ParkWithUs styles carry checkout_time 12:00. Kept the city's 4 p.m. in the note.
SEASON: the engine's configuration carries season_start 04-22 / season_end 11-15 (not published text); the city's banner says closing November 1st. Only the closing date was written.

SEASONAL OPTION: the city allows a whole-season stay ('unless the campers pay for the entire season upfront or have a special permit through city hall'), but every one of the 20 RV sites is sold nightly online; not a long-stay concern.

PIN: stored 42.84320,-91.81630 is in the woods ~90-100 m NE of the RV sites (centroid about 42.84274,-91.81732); under 250 m, not corrected. The ParkWithUs camp point 42.844355,-91.81512 is at the main road, not the campground.
